summary.zh: 任免通知、组织架构、花名册：谁在哪个部门担任什么岗位、从何时到何时、向谁汇报
summary.en: Appointment notices, org charts and rosters: who held which post in which unit, from when to when, reporting to whom

description.zh: 一个具体的人：员工、干部、负责人。
description.en: A particular human being: an employee, officer or manager.

description.zh: 组织里的一个单位：部门、处室、事业部、分公司、团队。
description.en: A unit of an organisation: a department, division, business unit, branch or team.

description.zh: 一个职位或岗位：总经理、部门主任、项目负责人、财务经理。岗位是职位本身，不是担任它的人。
description.en: A post or position: general manager, department head, project lead. The post itself, not the person holding it.

description.zh: 人员入职、报到的日期。原文写「2019 年 7 月入职」「入职时间：2021-03-01」。
description.en: The date a person joined the organisation: 2019 年 7 月入职.

description.zh: 人员离职、退休或调离的日期。原文写「2024 年 3 月离职」。
description.en: The date a person left, retired or transferred out: 2024 年 3 月离职.

description.zh: 人员的职级或级别，照原文记：「P7」「正处级」「高级工程师」。
description.en: A person's grade or rank as written: P7, senior engineer.

description.zh: 人员的工号或员工编号。
主语人员属于宾语部门：「调入财务部」「研发中心员工张三」。方向：人员 → 部门。
description.en: The subject person belongs to the object department: 调入财务部. Direction: person → department.

description.zh: 主语人员担任宾语岗位：「任命李四为市场部经理」「周敏担任心内科主任」。方向：人员 → 岗位。
description.en: The subject person holds the object post: 任命李四为市场部经理. Direction: person → post.

description.zh: 主语人员向宾语人员汇报、受其领导：「向总经理汇报」「分管副总为王五」。方向：下级 → 上级。
description.en: The subject person reports to the object person: 向总经理汇报. Direction: subordinate → superior.

description.zh: 主语部门隶属于宾语部门：「财务部下设会计科」「研发中心归属技术事业部」。方向：下级部门 → 上级部门。
description.en: The subject department is part of the object department: 财务部下设会计科. Direction: sub-unit → parent unit.

question.zh: 某个时间段内，谁担任某个岗位？
question.en: Who held a given post during a period?

question.zh: 某个人属于哪个部门，向谁汇报？
question.en: Which department is a person in, and whom do they report to?

question.zh: 某个人什么时候入职、什么时候离职？
question.en: When did a person join, and when did they leave?

question.zh: 某个部门下设哪些部门，有哪些人？
question.en: Which units sit under a department, and who is in them?
